description: This file defines a class CheckToStringNode used within the Twig templating engine to verify if an expression can be safely converted to a string under sandboxing rules. It includes methods for construction and compilation of the node, ensuring legal __toString() conversions.

classes.name: CheckToStringNode
classes.description: A node representing a check for whether an expression can be be safely cast to a string when sandboxing is enabled in Twig.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a CheckToStringNode with the given expression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code that performs the sandbox check for toString permission.
